typical_symptoms: Unexplained fever lasting several days
Generalized body ache and fatigue
Persistent cough without severe distress
Uncontrolled high blood sugar or hypertension checkup
Loss of appetite and weight loss
Mild to moderate abdominal discomfort or indigestion
red_flags: High continuous fever with rigors > 103 F

typical_symptoms: Fever in children under 14 years
Childhood vomiting and watery diarrhea
Poor feeding in infant
Childhood rash or measles/chickenpox suspicion
Wheezing or noisy breathing in toddlers
Delayed developmental milestones or growth issues
Chest heaviness or discomfort during physical walking
Palpitations or rapid irregular heartbeats
Shortness of breath on lying flat (orthopnea)
Swelling in both feet and ankles (bilateral pedal edema)
Dizziness or transient lightheadedness on standing
History of previous heart attack or stent placement
red_flags: Acute central crushing chest pain with arm/jaw radiation

typical_symptoms: Irregular or painful menstrual cycles
Antenatal pregnancy routine check-ups
Pelvic pain or white discharge
PCOD symptoms (facial hair, weight gain, irregular menses)
Post-menopausal spotting or bleeding
Family planning and preconception counseling
Itchy skin rashes, eczema, or fungal ringworm patches
Severe facial acne, pimples, or blemishes
Sudden patch of hair loss (alopecia) or dandruff
Nail discoloration or fungal thickening
Dry cracked skin or psoriasis plaques
Unusual mole color or border changes
red_flags: Rapidly spreading blistered rash with mucosal shedding

typical_symptoms: Ear ache, ear discharge, or decreased hearing
Severe sore throat, difficulty swallowing, or hoarseness
Chronic sinus congestion, facial pressure, or post-nasal drip
Frequent nosebleeds (epistaxis)
Vertigo or room-spinning dizziness
Tinnitus (ringing in the ears)
red_flags: Inability to swallow saliva with stridor
